messages:
Taylor B: Heads-up from testing on a foldable phone — when the viewport snaps from folded to unfolded the left rail stays in its small-state but the header switches to wide, so the sticky table header overlaps the condensed nav. Repro steps: open models list, rotate, then open a row.

Ravi K: Oh interesting. Which breakpoint are we using for the folded state? I think some devices report a width that sits between our 600 and 720 breakpoints.

Taylor B: Device reported 660px after unfold. Previously saw similar at 640 on some Android tablets.

Elena S: UX idea: instead of snap-switching styles at a single px value, we should animate a morph between states for widths in a 40px range. That could avoid the header jump. Also make sticky header offset dynamic based on nav height.

Ravi K: Technically doable. Would add CSS vars for --nav-height and transition them. Example:```css
:root { --nav-height: 56px; }
.header.sticky { transform: translateY(var(--nav-height)); transition: transform 180ms ease; }
```

Elena S: Also suggest adding a small affordance when nav is condensed: a tiny drag-handle so users know it's expandable. Keeps discoverability without forcing overlay.

Design Bot: Quick accessibility reminder: any drag affordance needs proper aria-label and keyboard activation (space/enter to toggle). Also ensure reduced-motion preference respects the morph animation.

Taylor B: For the table overflow on narrow widths we saw full-width JSON blobs causing the table to push horizontally. Could we truncate with a linked "view" pill that opens a modal? Less horizontal scrolling for sure.

Ravi K: Truncate+pill is fine. Let's cap cell text to ~48 characters on mobile with CSS clamp and show pill only when content-length > clamp. Example:```css
.cell-content { max-width: 14ch; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.view-pill { margin-left: 8px; }
```

Elena S: One more nit: table focus states disappear when you swipe the nav in. Probably because the nav steals focus. Ensure focus is programmatically restored to the table row after nav close, and add aria-hidden on the nav while closed to avoid screenreader confusion.

qa-bot: Visual diff flagged header shift at narrow widths (regression id: reg-2026-03-23-07). Also failing keyboard-nav test for condensed nav items (tab order issue).

Ravi K: I'll add a tabindex patch and a small focus-restoration util:```js
function restoreFocus(el) { requestAnimationFrame(()=> el.focus()); }
```

Taylor B: Copy tweak: the condensed nav label "Models" -> "Model (active)" was proposed but maybe too wordy. What about just showing model name + small chevron? Keeps it compact.

Elena S: Yes prefer model name + chevron. Add an aria-describedby for the chevron toggle so screen readers get context.

viewport-bot: Deployed preview: https://preview.redwood/ux/foldable-fixes (build 2026.03.23-1432)

Taylor B: Thanks — action list: Ravi to push focus & tabindex fixes, Elena to prototype morph animation & affordance, I will run another round of foldable testing on Monday. QA will re-run visual tests after changes.
